description: GLEIF LEI canonical entity reference + relationship subset. R0 skeleton per ADR-2605263800 §3 (LeiSensor). The LEI is the canonical cross-jurisdiction key — other corp lexicons (`registryAttestation`, `disclosureAttestation`, `ownershipEdge`, `filingEvent`) set their `entityLei` by resolving the local registry ID against records of this type. GLEIF data is CC0 1.0 (Tier-A globally). `parentLei` + `ultimateParentLei` capture GLEIF L2 (Relationship Records) direct + ultimate parent edges when published by the LEI registrant.

parentLei.description: GLEIF L2 direct-parent LEI when published. NULL otherwise.

ultimateParentLei.description: GLEIF L2 ultimate-parent LEI when published. NULL otherwise.

tier.description: GLEIF data is canonically Tier-A (CC0 1.0). No Tier-B path for this lexicon.
